entities.name: Methyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The reactant terminates in C(=O)O[C], while the product terminates in C(=O)O; this is consistent with conversion of a methyl ester to a carboxylic acid by hydrolysis or saponification.
Likely reagent classes include aqueous LiOH, NaOH, or KOH, followed by acidification; aqueous acidic hydrolysis is also chemically plausible.
